db_name.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database where pglogical metadata and tick records are stored.

db_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server.

db_user.description: Database user (with superuser or replication privileges) used to connect.

db_pass.description: Password for the database user. Leave blank to use peer authentication or .pgpass.

db_sslmode.description: SSL connection mode: disable, allow, prefer, require, verify-ca, or verify-full.

db_connect_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for connection establishment.

tick_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between each replication lag tick. Minimum recommended: 15.

schema_name.description: Schema to contain the tick table (created automatically on first run if missing).

tick_table.description: Name of the table used to store tick timestamps per replication set.

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain tick records before automatic purging.

verbose.description: Enable or disable verbose logging output to the log file (true/false).

replication_sets.description: List of logical replication sets (publications) to monitor for lag.

name.description: Name of the replication set (publication) on the provider.

provider.description: Connection string (e.g., host=localhost port=5432 dbname=mydb) for the provider node.

post_tick_cmd.description: Optional shell command to execute after each tick (e.g., for alerting). Use with caution; ensure script is executable.

log_file.description: Path to the log file where ticker output is written.
